artwork.prompt: Playlist cover artwork, square format, evocative rather than literal. A 2015-present cover. Medium: 3D render with soft global illumination and matte clay materials. Subject: a bare hedgerow against low white sky. Palette: desaturated ochre, moss green, bone white, overcast grey. Composition: a single object floating in an infinite seamless ground, long soft shadow. No text, lettering, typography, watermarks, logos or signatures anywhere in the image.
